cmsConfig.aboutContent:
APNA SHOES was founded with a singular conviction: every Indian deserves sneakers that turn heads, feel like walking on clouds, and cost a fraction of imported hype-brands.

From Delhi’s bustling metro stations to Bengaluru’s tech hubs and Mumbai’s sea-breeze promenades, we build footwear tailored to Indian foot shapes, climate conditions, and high-intensity daily commutes. Every pair is rigorously tested for durability, cushioning, and grip.

Har kadam, apna style — because style belongs to everyone.

faqList.question: What is Apna Shoes’ 7-Day Return & Refund Policy?
faqList.answer: We provide a 100% hassle-free 7-calendar-day return window starting the day your order is marked Delivered. If the shoe doesn’t fit, looks different, or has any stitching defect, request a return from "My Orders" or the "Return Requests" page. Our courier partner will pick it up from your doorstep at no cost and your refund will be credited in 3–5 working days.

faqList.question: Is Cash on Delivery (COD) supported across India?
faqList.answer: Yes! Cash on Delivery is available across 19,000+ Indian PIN codes. You can pay cash or scan the courier’s UPI QR code at the time of doorstep delivery.

faqList.question: How do I choose the correct shoe size?
faqList.answer: All Apna Shoes are sized using standard Indian / UK sizing (UK 6 to UK 11). If you normally wear UK 8 in Indian footwear, select UK 8. For wide feet, we recommend choosing one size up for maximum comfort.

faqList.question: How long does shipping take?
faqList.answer: Metro cities (Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata) receive orders in 2 to 3 business days. Non-metro cities and tier-2/tier-3 towns receive delivery within 3 to 5 business days via Shiprocket, Delhivery, and BlueDart.

faqList.question: Are online payments secure?
faqList.answer: All online transactions are powered by Razorpay using bank-grade 256-bit encryption. We support UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit/Debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), and Net Banking. We never store your card details.

cmsConfig.returnPolicyContent:
At APNA SHOES, we stand firmly behind the quality of our craftsmanship.

7-DAY RETURN WINDOW:
You have 7 calendar days from the exact delivery timestamp recorded by our courier partner to request a return or size exchange.

CONDITIONS FOR RETURN:
- Footwear must be unworn and in original condition with tags and original box intact.
- Items damaged due to rough outdoor usage after delivery are not eligible.
- Defective or wrong items are replaced or refunded with zero deduction.

DOORSTEP PICKUP & REFUNDS:
Once your return request is approved by our team, our courier partner will arrive for reverse pickup within 24 to 48 hours. After pickup inspection, your refund is initiated immediately to your original payment method (or bank UPI for COD orders).
cmsConfig.shippingPolicyContent:
SHIPPING CHARGES:
- FREE Shipping on all orders of ₹999 or above.
- Orders below ₹999 incur a standard shipping charge of ₹99.

DISPATCH & TRACKING:
All orders placed before 3:00 PM IST are dispatched on the same business day from our automated central warehouse. Once shipped, you will receive an SMS and WhatsApp update containing your live Shiprocket Airway Bill (AWB) tracking number.
cmsConfig.privacyPolicyContent:
APNA SHOES respects your personal privacy. We comply strictly with the Information Technology Act, 2000 and Digital Personal Data Protection guidelines.

We collect your name, phone number, shipping address, and email solely to process your orders, generate courier airway bills, and send shipment tracking updates. We never sell or lease your personal information to third parties.
cmsConfig.termsContent: By purchasing from APNA SHOES, you agree to our standard terms of sale. Prices are inclusive of 18% GST (Goods and Services Tax). We reserve the right to verify COD orders via automated OTP or phone confirmation before warehouse fulfillment.
